choice.basis: The chart displays May's pumping volume at approximately 800 m3, which is visually a severe outlier compared to all other months (ranging from ~17,500 to 40,000 m3). While no explicit numeric threshold is printed on the dashboard, the magnitude of the drop—falling well below the lowest other month and the 10,000 m3 gridline—constitutes a critical low-pumping anomaly rather than a standard follow-up case. The task context and the visual evidence of an extreme, isolated deviation support the escalation route.
choice.option_label: Escalate May to critical low-pumping anomaly review
